# Romain Jourdan's Blog

> Personal tech blog by Romain Jourdan covering cloud architecture, networking, software engineering, and technology leadership. Written from the perspective of someone who has worked as a Developer Advocate at AWS, a networking engineer, and a technology leader.

## About

- [About Romain](https://rjourdan.com/me/): Background and bio

## Cloud Architecture

- [Secure Connection between AWS VPC and a Raspberry Pi](https://rjourdan.com/pi-aws-vpc/): Step-by-step guide to establishing a site-to-site VPN between a Raspberry Pi at home and an AWS VPC using strongSwan
- [12-Factor App on Containers - re:Invent 2021](https://rjourdan.com/12-factor-app-reinvent2021/): A practical look at the 12-factor app methodology with building microservices on containers (AWS re:Invent talk)
- [AWS Containers A2Z - Introduction](https://rjourdan.com/aws-container-a2z-intro/): Introduction to a series on building containerized applications on AWS
- [AWS Step Functions integration with Amazon EKS](https://rjourdan.com/eks-stepfunction/): Launch blog for the AWS Step Functions integration with Amazon EKS

## Networking

- [What if the future of networking was networkless? Part 1](https://rjourdan.com/networkless-part1/): Visionary thoughts on the future of networking and whether networks as we know them will disappear
- [What if the future of networking was networkless? Part 2](https://rjourdan.com/networkless-part2/): Continuation of the networkless future exploration
- [Network Automation - How to Start?](https://rjourdan.com/network-automation-how-to-start/): Getting started with network automation using Python, Ansible, Docker, and Jupyter
- [SteelConnect EX SD-WAN Architecture Overview](https://rjourdan.com/ex-overview/): Introduction to Riverbed's SD-WAN solution architecture
- [SD-WAN Advanced Routing Capabilities](https://rjourdan.com/ex-advanced-routing/): Deep dive into SD-WAN routing features
- [SD-WAN Datacenter Integration](https://rjourdan.com/ex-dc-integration/): How to deploy SD-WAN gateways in datacenter environments
- [My Ultimate SD-WAN Solution](https://rjourdan.com/ultimate-sdwan/): Vision for an ideal SD-WAN deployment
- [Hybrid WAN - Drivers & Concept](https://rjourdan.com/hybrid-wan-drivers-concept/): Hybrid WAN fundamentals and use cases for remote workers

## Software Engineering

- [Rethinking Full Stack Development with Kiro - Voxxed Days CERN](https://rjourdan.com/voxxed-days-cern-rethinking-fullstack-kiro/): Conference talk on rethinking full stack application development with Kiro
- [Rethinking Full Stack Development with Kiro - Devoxx Ticino](https://rjourdan.com/devoxx-ticino-rethinking-fullstack-kiro/): Conference talk at Devoxx Ticino on modern full stack development

- [A Day in the Life of a Developer Advocate at AWS](https://rjourdan.com/a-day-in-life-da-aws/): Behind the scenes of the Developer Advocate role

- [Continuous Learning](https://rjourdan.com/continous-learning/): Applying Lean/Kaizen principles to personal and professional development
- [About Diversity](https://rjourdan.com/about-diversity/): Thoughts on diversity and inclusion in the tech industry
